title: A Continuous-Time Actor-Critic Framework for Jump-Diffusion Controls with Normalizing Flows
abstract: arXiv:2604.05398v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Continuous-time stochastic control with time-inhomogeneous jump-diffusion dynamics is central in finance and economics, but computing optimal policies is difficult under explicit time dependence, discontinuous shocks, and high dimensionality. We propose an actor-critic framework that serves as a mesh-free solver for entropy-regularized control problems and stochastic games with jumps. The approach is built on a time-inhomogeneous little q-function and an appropriate occupation measure, yielding a policy-gradient representation that accommodates time-dependent drift, volatility, and jump terms. To represent expressive stochastic policies in continuous-action spaces, we parameterize the actor using conditional normalizing flows, enabling flexible non-Gaussian policies while retaining exact likelihood evaluation for entropy regularization and policy optimization. translated_title: 一种基于归一化流的跳跃扩散控制连续时间演员-评论家框架
translated_abstract: 连续时间下具有时变跳跃扩散动力学的随机控制问题在金融和经济学中至关重要，但在存在显式时间依赖、不连续冲击以及高维度的情况下，计算最优策略十分困难。我们提出了一个演员-评论家框架，作为求解熵正则化控制问题和带跳跃随机博弈的无网格求解器。该方法建立在一个时变小q函数和适当的占位测度之上，得到一个能够处理时间依赖的漂移项、波动率项和跳跃项的策略梯度表示。为了在连续动作空间中表示具有强表达能力的随机策略，我们使用条件归一化流对演员进行参数化，从而实现灵活的非高斯策略，同时保留精确的似然评估以支持熵正则化和策略优化。我们在时变线性二次控制等问题上验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于条件归一化流的连续时间演员-评论家框架，作为无网格求解器处理带时变跳跃扩散动力学的熵正则化控制问题和随机博弈，能够灵活优化非高斯策略并处理时间依赖的漂移、波动率和跳跃项。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a continuous-time actor-critic framework using conditional normalizing flows as a mesh-free solver for entropy-regularized control problems and stochastic games with time-inhomogeneous jump-diffusion dynamics, enabling flexible non-Gaussian policies while handling time-dependent drift, volatility, and jump terms.
